# Recorder test fixtures: where every byte came from

All reports here are real Chainlink Data Streams answers on testnet (`https://api.testnet-dataengine.chain.link`),
fetched with Mako Market's key by scripts that never print or save a key, secret or header. Checksums in `SHA256SUMS`
(`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` from this folder). Tests that need a case no capture showed change ONE field of a real
report (`test/helpers.ts` `withWord`) and say so in the test name ("derived").

## capture-2026-10-16/

From `mako-design/bench/recorder-capture/2026-10-16T19-11-36-228Z/` (script `mako-design/scripts/recorder-capture.mjs`,
run by Joshua 2026-10-16 19:11 UTC; CHARTS_DS_PLAN 15.1). Copied byte for byte. Each file records the request path
(`/api/v1/reports/page?feedID=...&startTimestamp=...&limit=100`), the purpose and the time.

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `open-minute-{BTC,EURUSD,XAUUSD,AAPL}.json` | one page of 100 from 2026-10-15 15:00:00 UTC, one per class (US session, FX and metals open) |
| `nyse-open-AAPL.json` | 2026-10-15 13:29 to 13:31 UTC, two pages: the NYSE open (status 1 -> 2) |
| `nyse-close-AAPL.json` | 2026-10-15 19:59 to 20:01 UTC, two pages: the NYSE close (status 2 -> 1) |
| `metals-break-start-XAUUSD.json` | 2026-10-15 20:59 to 21:01 UTC, two pages: the metals daily break |
| `weekend-EURUSD.json` | 2026-10-10 12:00 UTC: a weekend minute (closed) |
| `live-page-{BTC,EURUSD}.json` | one page of 100 from 2026-10-16 19:09:00 UTC, as the live tick fetches it |

## probe-2026-09-18/

From `mako-design/bench/datastreams-probe/2026-09-18T12-44-34-398Z-p2/` (`page-BTC.json`, `page-EURUSD.json`), the
probe that first measured `/reports/page`: 100 reports each, BTC obs 1789734915 to 1789735014, EUR/USD 1789734916 to
1789735015 (CHARTS_DS_PLAN 15.2 (b) and (c)).

## reference-ohlc.json

Generated by `scripts/reference_ohlc.py` (independent Python, CHARTS_DS_PLAN 15.4) from `capture-2026-10-16/`. CI
re-runs it with `--check`.

## reference-rollups.json

Generated by `scripts/reference_rollups.py` (independent Python, CHARTS_DS_PLAN 3.5 and 15.4) from
`reference-ohlc.json`: every 15m, 1h, 1d, 2h and 4h bucket of the captured minutes at three horizons. CI re-runs it
with `--check`. Like `reference-ohlc.json` it is computed, not captured, so it is not in `SHA256SUMS`.

## Also used, not copied

`cf-worker/test/fixtures/fixture-btcusd-1789529160.json` and `btcusd-1789529160-verified.json`: the BTC report of
2026-09-16 03:26:00 UTC and its decode checked against `VerifierProxy.verify` on Monad testnet at block 62922075
(the resolver's fixtures; read in place).
